sections.title: Sample recipe and three tests
sections.what: Builds a sample saved recipe and runs three tests on it: a refresh that keeps the saved research and date, a refresh that keeps the old coverage note, and a check that an invalid recipe is rejected.
sections.why: Likely reason: to confirm the refresh does not change saved research.
sections.watch_out: The sample uses one fixed date, so the cover date check only matches that date.

summary: Tests that refreshing an old lessons recipe updates its layout while leaving its research and date unchanged.
purpose: Checks that the refresh function behaves as intended on a sample saved recipe.
why: The tests protect saved research from accidental change during a layout refresh. Reason beyond that not stated in the code.
how: Builds a sample saved recipe, runs the refresh with and without coverage, and checks that the saved copy is unchanged, the old slide is removed and the cover date stays the same. A second test checks that legacy coverage is kept. A third checks that an invalid recipe throws.
inputs: A built-in sample recipe. No external data is read.
outputs: Pass or fail results from Node's test runner.
risks: The sample covers only three cases. A change to the sample's shape could make tests fail for reasons unrelated to the code.
debug: Run this test file with the project's test runner. If the sample fails to parse, check the saved recipe schema. Compare the expected slide names with what the builder produces.
